summary: The audit checks the Data Science Core, the BS Extended Core, the WIM, one capstone option and your subplan, with every course letter graded and counted toward one requirement only. The exceptions the text makes are the proof-writing course, which can also count elsewhere, and the WIM courses (DATASCI 120, 192A, 192B and 199W), which also count toward the capstone. Technical electives must be at least 3 units each. You check by hand the one CR course the program may allow (never for probability, theoretical statistics, the WIM or the capstone), an independent research capstone or non-PWR Notation elective, the Capstone Showcase, and for honors the proposal, the 3.5 GPA in major courses, the 15 upper-level units and the final portfolio.

program.why: Grading: "All courses that fulfill major requirements must be taken for a letter grade. Students may be granted a one-time exception to use one course taken for credit (CR) toward the major. This exception does not apply to the probability requirement, theoretical statistics requirements, WIM, and capstone, which must always be taken for a letter grade." The one-time CR exception is moved in by hand.

z1WA71CN.why: Policies: "Double-counting within the major is not allowed, unless explicitly stated otherwise." The capstone counts once, as the capstone. The WIM block stays a designation because the text says otherwise for it: "DATASCI 120, DATASCI 192A, DATASCI 192B, and DATASCI 199W double count with the capstone requirement."

yNIMhppV.why: "Writing in the Major (WIM): Complete at least 1 of the following Courses: DATASCI 120, DATASCI 192A AND DATASCI 192B, DATASCI 199W". DATASCI 192A and 192B are one option together; the data split them, so either alone passed. "DATASCI 120, DATASCI 192A, DATASCI 192B, and DATASCI 199W double count with the capstone requirement."

qWiF07Z5.why: Notes, with the page's course link filled in: "Most students should take CS 106A. However, students with prior programming experience in a language other than Python may instead take [CS 193Q]." The CS 106A waiver after DATASCI 112 is marked met by hand.

zhXehV9X.why: "Complete ALL of the following Courses: STATS 118, STATS 200 OR STATS 200Q". Notes, with the page's course links filled in: "students may substitute [MATH 151] or [STATS 116X] in place of both STATS 117 and STATS 118." One MATH 151 or STATS 116X fills both the probability rule and the STATS 118 slot, so that option shares.
